tools.name: search_businesses
tools.description: Search the Muyiribi Uganda business directory by keyword, category, and/or district, and show the matches as a card list.

tools.name: get_business
tools.description: Fetch full public details for one business listing by id, including contact info (phone, WhatsApp, email, website). Use the id returned by search_businesses.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List every business category available in the directory, so a search can be narrowed to an exact category name.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_business · Private data: get_business · Public sink: get_business.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_business · Private data: get_business · Public sink: get_business

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
